title: Identifying Market Structure

edits.reason: Lesson teaches the full sequence 'range -> fake-out -> impulse -> S/R flip' and calls the retest the 'cleanest, lowest-risk entry'. (1) A 'lowest-risk' long needs a visible defined risk: stop @98 sits just below the 100 flip level and below the to:101 retest low, in-band [89-120], pairing the existing 'S/R flip — entry' @13 with a drawn stop. (2) The deviation/fake-out is explicitly taught ('Price typically deviates slightly to take out stop losses before the real move begins... designed to shake out weak hands'); dataIndex 5 is the bottom of the to:96 pullback (leg2, bars 4-5) that follows the first push to 99, i.e. the shake-out before the impulse. Both indices/levels are authored like existing markPoints (no offset) and do not duplicate or contradict the existing flip line @100 (teal).

notes: Both auditor lessonChart gaps are valid and accepted unchanged (stop markLine @98 pink; deviation markPoint @5 bottom). Coordinate checks pass: lessonChart legs 91->99(4)->96(2)->100(2)->109(3)->101(3)->118(4)=18 bars, band ~89-120; yAxis 98 in-band, dataIndex 5 = bottom of the 96 fake-out, dataIndex within 0-17. REJECTED the auditor's introChart gap (S/R-flip markPoint @17): the auditor itself rated it low/optional and recommended leaving intro as-is, and I concur — introChart is the consolidation->expansion CONCEPT surface, the lessonChart is the dedicated S/R-flip teaching surface, and adding a flip pin would crowd the existing Expansion!/New HH callouts. quiz.chart confirmed complete: cutIndex:13 keeps range context pre-reveal without spoiling the bullish-expansion answer, and revealMarkPoints already annotate the breakout outcome; the rule's '$100 retest' is post-decision guidance and the chart's legs don't actually produce a retest, so nothing to add. No target/TP line added — the lesson names no specific target level (the existing '+18%' marker already shows the outcome), so a target line would be an invention.
